snippet.title: Kick'n Hell Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Kick'n Hell is now live on Steam!! Play and compete with a huge launch contest of €1400 live right now!! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832070/Kickn_Hell/

Hello fellow gamers! We are Fire Foot Studios, and we just released our very first game, Kick’n Hell.

Kick'n Hell is our take on the new and upcoming Foddian genre: tough, unforgiving, and all about getting back up when you fall. 
Your goal? Reach the top of Hell where Satan himself awaits. 
Your only way up? Your powerful feet.

It can be challenging at first, but once it clicks, it’s incredibly satisfying. If you feel like giving it a go, you can try the free demo on Steam before going in for the real deal: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2929030/Kickn_Hell_Demo/
And if you want to support us, giving a positive review on the game on Steam would mean the world to our small team. Thanks for being here!
